| WHERE priority == "critical" AND status != "closed"
| ENRICH precision-crm-accounts-enrich ON account_id
| WHERE churn_risk_score > 0.7
| KEEP company_name, ticket_id, priority, status, churn_risk_score, account_owner
| SORT churn_risk_score DESC"}

{"query":"FROM precision-support-tickets
